The site reads it, and scripts/stamp-copy.mjs writes it into README.md, package.json and funding.json; pnpm check fails if they drift. {components}, {ai} and {frameworks} are filled in from the catalog and the frameworks list below, so counts and lists are never typed by hand. name: Keyframery
tagline: The component library for Vercel's UI SDK.
description: Free, open-source components for Vercel's UI SDK: quiet by default, lively when you want it, sheets on phones and Agent view. Install them with the shadcn CLI.
summary: UI SDK is Vercel's library of UI behaviours: keyboard, focus, selection, accessibility and a bridge that lets AI agents read and use your interface. Keyframery is the component library on top. Every component renders UI SDK underneath and adds a finished look and motion written in plain CSS, and the shadcn CLI copies the code into your project, so it's yours.

highlights.title: {components} components
highlights.body: Everything UI SDK ships, plus cards, charts, data tables, sidebars and more, each with a live demo and a Customize panel.

highlights.title: Quiet by default
highlights.body: Subtle moves about as much as shadcn/ui. Calm, Springy, Snappy and Playful turn the motion up with one attribute. No animation library.

highlights.title: Sheets on phones
highlights.body: Popovers, menus, selects and pickers open as a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens, and stay popovers everywhere else.

highlights.title: Agent view
highlights.body: See the snapshot an AI agent reads from every component and run its actions. A skill for Claude Code and a prompt for any coding agent.

highlights.title: Create and templates
highlights.body: Build a preset of colours, corners, font and motion and install it with one command. Two free templates: a landing page and an admin dashboard.

highlights.title: Your code
highlights.body: Installed with the shadcn CLI in {frameworks}. Free and MIT-licensed.
